qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global market leadership in severe-abrasion slurry pumps (Warman) and ground-engaging tools (ESCO) where proprietary metallurgy and mission-critical mine-site installed base drive ~70% recurring aftermarket revenue with exceptional pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Peace-of-Mind Balance Sheet). World-class mining slurry pump and wear-parts franchise (Warman, ESCO) with 70%+ recurring aftermarket revenue and 120%+ FCF conversion, but the £657m debt-funded acquisition of Micromine in 2025 pushed LT debt to 6.18x NI and net debt to 4.12x NI, breaching the <= 4.0x balance sheet threshold.
qualitative.evidence: While 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 12.9% and cumulative Owner FCF conversion is outstanding at 122.6% (£1,226m FCF on £1,000m NI), gross debt surged from £934.5m in 2024 to £1,526.5m in 2025 following the debt-funded Micromine transaction. LT debt / NI stands at 6.18x and net debt / NI is 4.12x, while interest coverage compressed to 5.68x, violating the <=4.0x balance sheet hurdle.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
